tile_grid.rule: tile (r,c) = rows [r*T,(r+1)*T), cols [c*T,(c+1)*T) from (0,0); pixels beyond the canvas count as not mesh-valid and are 0

canvas_mask_rule: canvas px (i,j) -> grid (floor(i*gh/H), floor(j*gw/W)) nearest neighbour (= i//20, j//20 here)

sv_mapping.canvas_to_level0: canvas px (i, j) = level-0 (row i, col j); in-plane shape equal to canvas_shape
sv_mapping.level2: shape (109, 17440, 42500), scale (2.4, 9.6, 9.6) um, downsampling_method mean; canvas px (i, j) -> level-2 (i // 4, j // 4)
sv_mapping.depth: 109 slices at 2.4 um at every level; centre slice 54 = mesh surface (DECL-P4-5); slab 32..76
